events.title: January draws to a close with 아스널 still top of the Premier League, two points above second placed 맨체스터 유나이티드 and within a game in hand. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, 첼시 and 에버턴 complete the top five. 리버풀's decline continues as they occupy eighth place, deepening fears that a side looking all set for title glory three months ago might now not even qualify for the UEFA Cup. Meanwhile, 웨스트브로미치 앨비언's dismal form continues as they and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 prop up the rest of the top flight on goal difference. 선덜랜드 occupy the last relegation place. 미들즈브러 boost their bid for a UEFA Cup place by spending a total of £8.5million on new signings Chris Riggott , Malcolm Christie and Michael Ricketts . The true extent of 리즈 유나이티드's financial difficulties becomes public knowledge during a press conference to announce the sale of Jonathan Woodgate to 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 for £9million, during which 테리 베너블스 states that he had been assured players wouldn't need to be sold. 포츠머스 and 레스터 시티 remain in pole position at the top of Division One, and apart from 코번트리 시티 edging Reading out of the playoff zone the top six of the division is unchanged from last month.

There will now be a place in the UEFA Cup for the Premier League's sixth place team if 맨체스터 유나이티드 or 리버풀 (who contest this weekend's League Cup final) finish in the top five. Currently in sixth place are 찰턴 애슬레틱, while 리버풀 are still only seventh in a division which they had looked set to win a few months ago. 포츠머스 have a two-point lead over 레스터 시티 at the top of Division One. Reading, 노팅엄 포리스트 and 셰필드 유나이티드 remain in the playoff zone, but an improving 울버햄프턴 원더러스 side have edged 노리치 시티 out of the top six. 로더럼 유나이티드 are in contention for promotion after an impressive season so far.

Bolton are safe after a 2–1 home win over 미들즈브러. 선덜랜드's 4–0 home defeat to 아스널 sees them end the season as officially the worst Premier League team ever with a record low of four wins, 19 points and 21 goals. Not since 스토크 시티 in the old First Division 18 years ago has any top flight club attained such a poor record in the top flight. Ninth-placed 맨체스터 시티 bid farewell to Maine Road after 80 years, their last game before relocation to the City of Manchester Stadium being watched by a 35,000 capacity crowd as they lost 1–0 to eighth placed 사우샘프턴. events.title: Cameroonian soccer player Marc-Vivien Foé collapsed during a Confederations Cup semi-final between Cameroon and Colombia in Lyon , France. He subsequently died after doctors failed to resuscitate him. He played for 리옹 and was loaned to 맨체스터 시티 F.C. in the 2002/03 season.
